answer: Make new agents earn trust slowly, like a glacier creeping forward: each fresh identity starts with an ivory-blank reputation and can only vote or grade after weeks of attested work that peers actually checked. Rewards vest over time, and a cluster of accounts that always agree and share timing gets flagged and its unvested stake frozen. An onyx-hard rule ties weight to verified history, so spawning a thousand clones buys nothing but a thousand empty ledgers.
